local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")
local old=world:FindFirstChild("IslandDecor")
if old then old:Destroy() end
local decor=Instance.new("Folder"); decor.Name="IslandDecor"; decor.Parent=world
local function part(name,size,pos,color,material,parent)
 local p=Instance.new("Part"); p.Name=name;p.Size=size;p.Position=pos;p.Anchored=true;p.Color=color;p.Material=material;p.Parent=parent or decor;return p
end
local TOP=20.5
local function tree(x,z,s)
 s=s or 1
 local h=7*s
 part("TreeTrunk",Vector3.new(2*s,h,2*s),Vector3.new(x,TOP+h/2,z),Color3.fromRGB(92,62,39),Enum.Material.Wood)
 local c=part("TreeCrown",Vector3.new(7*s,7*s,7*s),Vector3.new(x,TOP+h+2.6*s,z),Color3.fromRGB(64,126,65),Enum.Material.Grass)
 c.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
end
local function rock(x,z,s)
 local h=3*s
 local r=part("Rock",Vector3.new(4*s,h,4*s),Vector3.new(x,TOP+h/2-.15,z),Color3.fromRGB(92,98,104),Enum.Material.Rock)
 r.Orientation=Vector3.new(0,math.random(0,180),0)
end
tree(-18,-15,.9);tree(18,-12,1.05);tree(-19,14,.75);tree(19,15,.8)
rock(-11,-20,.8);rock(14,18,.65);rock(20,3,.55);rock(-20,1,.7)
local pedestal=part("CorePedestal",Vector3.new(10,1.5,10),Vector3.new(0,21.25,0),Color3.fromRGB(62,69,82),Enum.Material.Slate)
local ring=part("CoreRing",Vector3.new(.6,11,11),Vector3.new(0,22.05,0),Color3.fromRGB(75,165,255),Enum.Material.Neon)
ring.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder;ring.CanCollide=false
local sign=part("WelcomeSign",Vector3.new(12,5,.7),Vector3.new(0,23,-22),Color3.fromRGB(93,66,43),Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)
local surface=Instance.new("SurfaceGui");surface.Face=Enum.NormalId.Back;surface.Parent=sign
local text=Instance.new("TextLabel");text.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);text.BackgroundTransparency=1;text.Text="GROW THE ISLAND\nCollect Energy • Upgrade the Core";text.TextWrapped=true;text.TextScaled=true;text.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;text.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,244,210);text.Parent=surface
print("Island visuals fixed")

local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")
local core=world:WaitForChild("EnergyCore")
local old=core:FindFirstChild("ProximityPrompt")
if old then old:Destroy() end
local prompt=Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.Name="GrowPrompt";prompt.ObjectText="Energy Core";prompt.ActionText="Grow Island";prompt.KeyboardKeyCode=Enum.KeyCode.E;prompt.HoldDuration=.25;prompt.MaxActivationDistance=14;prompt.RequiresLineOfSight=false;prompt.Parent=core
local costs={10,30,70,140}
local names={"Expansion1","Expansion2","Bridge","TreasureIsland"}
local function showStage(n)
 local p=world:FindFirstChild(names[n]);if p then p.Transparency=0;p.CanCollide=true end
end
local busy={}
prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
 if busy[player] then return end;busy[player]=true
 local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats");local energy=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Energy");local stage=player:FindFirstChild("IslandStage")
 if energy and stage then
  if stage.Value>=#costs then prompt.ActionText="Island Complete!" else
   local cost=costs[stage.Value+1]
   if energy.Value>=cost then energy.Value-=cost;stage.Value+=1;showStage(stage.Value) end
   if stage.Value<#costs then prompt.ActionText="Grow Island - "..costs[stage.Value+1].." Energy" else prompt.ActionText="Island Complete!" end
  end
 end
 task.wait(.3);busy[player]=nil
end)
print("Energy Core interaction fix loaded")
